description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'path-walk' API within a Git project. It sets up a repository with various commits, tags, and directory structures, then runs multiple test cases to verify the behavior and output of the 'path-walk' tool under different options and scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs provided commands, and verifies output.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Executes the 'path-walk' command with specified arguments.

methods.name: test_cmp_sorted
methods.description: Compares the actual output with expected output, ignoring order.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the environment timestamp to ensure unique commit timestamps.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to execute after the test completes.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts lines matching a pattern in the output.
